title: Smoky Lamb Tagine
description: A traditional North African-inspired tagine, infused with smoky flavors and Italian flair.

ingredients.name: algerian spice blend
ingredients.notes: or substitute with a combination of cumin, coriander, and cinnamon

instructions: Season the lamb with salt, pepper, and Algerian spice blend.
Heat the olive oil in a large Dutch oven over medium-high heat.
Sear the lamb until browned on all sides, about 5 minutes.
Remove the lamb from the pot and set aside.
Add the chopped onion and minced garlic to the pot and sauté until softened, about 5 minutes.
Stir in the smoked paprika and cook for 1 minute.
Add the tomato paste and cook for 1 minute, stirring constantly.
Add the chicken broth and bring the mixture to a simmer.
Return the lamb to the pot and cover with a lid.
Transfer the pot to the preheated oven and braise the lamb for 2 1/2 hours, or until tender.
Remove the pot from the oven and stir in the honey, if using.
Serve the lamb with the braising liquid spooned over the top.
